snippet.title: TankRat | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Scavenge. Scrap. Survive. 

In the aftermath of a war that reduced the world’s most glorious city to ash, the remnants of mankind’s greed spread like mechanical cancer across the world. 

Only steel remains. 

TankRat comes to PC via Steam and Epic Games, and PlayStation 5 on January 15th.
https://www.tankrat.com/linkhub
